Growing oyster mushrooms

Oyster mushrooms colonise straw within two weeks when kept at twenty degrees.

Mist the fruiting bags twice a day and harvest before the caps flatten out. This keeps the flavour mild and the texture firm for the kitchen.

Spent substrate makes excellent compost for the vegetable garden, closing the loop between kitchen and soil in a few simple steps.
